articles.highlight: GALA聚焦真实生活脑电视觉解码，针对被试内表现强而现有方法仍失败的问题提出图库级对齐。
articles.summary: 该论文提出GALA，将图库级对齐用于从EEG解码真实生活视觉体验。摘要称EEG视觉解码在被试内设置中表现较强，而现有方法仍有失败，因此该工作关注更接近真实生活的图库级解码场景。所给摘要文本在“fail to ge”处截断，具体方法、数据和结论尚无法核实。
articles.failureAnalysis: 可用摘要仅到“current methods fail to ge”便截断，未提供GALA的具体方法、实验设置或量化结果；因此无法判断其是否真正改善真实生活EEG解码。
articles.sourceExcerpt: GALA: Gallery-Level Alignment for Real-Life Vision Decoding from EEG Philippe Forest1 Giulia Lioi1 Mai Quyen Pham1 Alix Lamouroux2 Adrien Merlini1 Javen Shi3 1IMT Atlantique, France 2Center for Mind/Brain Sciences (CIMeC), University of Trento, Italy 3Australian Institute for Machine Learning, University of Adelaide, Australia Abstract Neural decoding of visual experience from electroen- cephalography (EEG) has achieved strong performance in intra-subject settings, but current methods fail to generalize across individuals: on the standard 200-way benchmark THINGS-EEG-2, top-1 accuracy drops from above 80% within subjects to about 32% for an unseen subject. Adapting a pre-trained encoder to new subjects and sessions typically requires labeled data, a bottleneck whose collection time severely limits practical device deployment. In a practi- cal Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), however, the possible outcomes are known in advance and form a gallery of can- didates, and the unlabeled EEG of the user accumulates as soon as the device is used.

articles.title: mdiri-ai/SoduWork
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: SoduWork 是 GitHub 上一个获得 4145 stars 的开源项目，定位为团队及其 AI 智能体的“AI 原生引擎”，强调多运行框架、多智能体与自托管能力。它值得关注是因为它瞄准的是企业级智能体落地的组织与编排层，而非单一模型能力，自托管也回应了数据合规诉求。但仓库公开信息仅有描述与热度，产品成熟度与真实使用价值仍需进一步验证。
articles.failureAnalysis: 多智能体编排赛道竞争激烈，LangGraph、AutoGen 等开源方案已占据开发者心智，仅靠“AI 原生引擎”的定位难以形成清晰差异化。自托管虽然迎合合规需求，却把部署、运维与模型接入成本转移给客户，容易在缺少成熟文档与生态时流失试用者。4145 stars 属于早期热度信号，若无法证明具体场景下的效率提升与稳定收益，项目可能停留在演示阶段而难以形成付费或长期贡献。
